Case Diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
This is the First application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 28/11/2022 by Police Station- Radhogarh, District- Guna (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.534/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 376(D),
366 and 506 of IPC.

Prosecution story, in short, is that on 27/11/2022, the complainant lodged a computerized complaint against the applicant- Vijay Bunkar and co-accused- Govind Bunkar stating that Vijay Bunkar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79461825/
1 construction work was going on at her home and her husband had given the work of construction to the co-accused- Govinda, due to which, he used to come at her home and he had taken her mobile number.

sentences.text: On 15/07/2022 at about 12:00 PM, when the complainant alongwith his husband and children was sleeping then co-accused- Govinda called and said her to come outside the house.
Thereafter, the complainant, without waking up her husband, went outside the house where co-accused- Govinda told her to walk with him quietly, if she shouted, he would kill her.

Due to fear,
she silently accompanied the co-accused- Govinda.
He took her to the applicant's house and applicant opened the door and both of them took her into a room on the second floor and threw her on the cot lying there.
Applicant caught hold of her hands and co-accused- Govinda raped her forcefully.
both of them raped with the complainant 22 times and threatened her not to narrate the incident to anyone.
Due to fear, she did not tell about this incident to anyone.
After that, both of accused persons committed rape with her at the room of the applicant several times.
On 05/08/2022, co-accused- Govinda called her at the room of the applicant and committed rape with her one by one.
They used to say her that they have made her videos and if she had not come in future, they would viral the same.
Thereafter, by threatening of making viral videos, they used to commit rape with her.
On the basis of aforesaid, crime has been registered against the applicant and co-accused.
She was sent for medical examination.
Applicant was arrested on 28/11/2022 and after investigation, charge sheet has been submitted.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is aged 32 years and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 28/11/2022.
Investigation has almost completed.
Applicant is the permanent resident of District- Guna (M.P.) and there is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On such premise, prayer for grant of bail to the applicant is made.
Learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash security of Rs.25,000/- along with a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving any notice.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for necessary compliance.
